title: multiqc
description:
MultiQC aggregates results from bioinformatics analyses across many samples into a single report.
It searches a given directory for analysis logs and compiles a HTML report. It's a general use tool, perfect for summarising the output from numerous bioinformatics tools.

input.help_text: type: `array`, multiple: True, required, direction: `input`, example: `input.txt`

output.description: Create report in the specified output directory.
output.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `path/to/report`

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
